céilí band 和 session 是同一種東西，只是人多一點。: A céilí band and a session are the same thing, only with more people.
céilí band 是為舞蹈而設的編制，需要固定編曲、明確拍點與大音量；ses: The céilí band is a line-up made for dancing: it needs fixed arrangements, a clear beat and plenty of volume. A session is a gathering that exists so that people can play together, and it runs on unison playing and tune sets. They share a repertoire but solve different problems.
céilí band 的場合是 céilí 舞會：一群人隨著音樂跳團體舞與雙人舞: The céilí band's occasion is the céilí dance: a room of people dancing group dances and couple dances to the music, where the band's job is to give a clear beat and enough volume. It shares its repertoire with the session, but plays it more tightly, closer to an arrangement.
céilí band 的編制不同：它需要音量，所以常以手風琴、小提琴、長笛、斑鳩: The céilí band's line-up is different: it needs volume, so it is usually made up of accordion, fiddle, flute, banjo, piano and guitar, with the bodhrán as the main percussion; some later bands added a drum kit and saxophone, though that already leans towards a show band set-up. Its aim is to be heard across a whole dance hall and to make the dancers' steps land clearly, so it favours instruments that can be loud.
céilí band 的邏輯不同。它需要整齊、需要音量、需要把拍點打給舞者聽，所: The céilí band works by a different logic. It needs tightness, volume and a beat the dancers can hear, so it has fixed arrangements and fixed sections: piano and bodhrán give a clear harmony and beat while the melody instruments play in unison. Its sound is thicker, because what it has to cut through is the footwork and conversation of an entire dance hall.
session 是開放的聚會，沒有固定團員，也沒有節目單。坐在旁邊的人可以拿出樂: A session is an open gathering with no fixed members and no programme. Someone sitting at the side can take out an instrument and join in; that is exactly how it works.
session 沒有固定編制。常見的組合是小提琴（fiddle）、愛爾蘭長笛（I: A session has no fixed line-up. The usual mix is fiddle, Irish flute, tin whistle, accordion, banjo, mandolin and bodhrán, with uilleann pipes and Irish harp appearing now and then. Numbers run from three or four people to a dozen or more, and instruments may double up.
session 的場合是酒館、家庭聚會、節慶與葬禮後的守靈聚會。它沒有觀眾與演奏: Sessions happen in pubs, at family gatherings, at festivals, and at wakes after a funeral. There is no line between audience and players: someone listening at the side may take out an instrument and join in on the next tune. This open participation is the session's most important social feature, and the reason it has been reproduced all over the world — a few people who know the same batch of tunes are enough to make a session.
session 的核心不是和聲，而是「齊奏」。所有人演奏同一條旋律，沒有主奏與伴: What a session is built on is not harmony but unison. Everyone plays the same melody, with no split between lead and accompaniment; the differences lie in each player's ornaments, in where they breathe, and in the timbre of the instrument. This has one technical consequence: if someone plays a wrong note the whole group hears it but does not stop, because the melody is shared and each player can pick it up again.
session 的樂器以自己的自然音量平衡，所以實音高的樂器（長笛、錫口笛、手風: Session instruments balance by their own natural volume, which is why instruments that sound at pitch (flute, tin whistle, accordion, fiddle) fit together most easily; banjo and mandolin are plucked, so their notes are short, and they earn their place with dense eighth notes. The drones of the uilleann pipes lay down a fixed harmonic floor, and their pitch cannot be changed on the spot, so a group playing with them has to meet their key. A céilí band, by contrast, often swaps in louder versions of the instruments, or fills the chords in more heavily on the piano, to push the beat through the dancers' steps.
session 的音量是「談出來的」。樂手在幾首曲子的過程中互相調整：誰的樂器太: A session's volume is talked out. Over the course of a few tunes the players adjust to each other: whose instrument is too loud, whose bodhrán is too busy — the others answer with volume and position, without a word. The balance is not a fixed value but something that shifts with the room, the number of people and the state of the day.
session 裡有主奏與伴奏的分別，像流行樂團一樣。: A session has a lead and an accompaniment, the way a pop band does.
一個曲組由兩到四首同類的曲子組成，例如一連串 reel，或一連串 jig。曲子之: A tune set is two to four tunes of the same kind, for instance a run of reels or a run of jigs. What links them is not harmony but rhythm type and key: usually the end of one tune joins the start of the next, in the same key or a related one. Players need no sheet music; what they remember is the sequence, this tune after that one, not a single tune on its own.
主要演奏旋律，同時以 drone 管提供持續低音、以 regulators 打出: Plays the melody while the drones sound a continuous bass and the regulators add chord notes — one of the few instruments in a session that gives melody and harmony at once
以 tipper 擊打鼓面標出拍點，另一手按壓鼓背改變音高，並在句尾加花、在長音: Strikes the head with a tipper to mark the beat while the other hand presses the back to change the pitch, adding ornament at the ends of phrases and leaving space under long notes
以撥片演奏旋律，偶爾以雙音或短促的和弦填充和聲縫隙: Plays the melody with a pick, now and then filling the gaps in the harmony with double stops or short chords
先抓節奏類型。四拍流動的是 reel，六拍分成兩組的是 jig，九拍分成三組的是: Get the rhythm type first. Four flowing beats is a reel, six beats in two groups of three is a jig, nine beats in three groups of three is a slip jig. Once you have that, listen to the melody.
刷和弦，提供和聲背景: Strums chords and provides a harmonic backdrop
協調靠的是「聽」與「看」。session 通常圍成圓圈，領奏的人用琴弓或笛子的抬: Coordination comes from listening and watching. A session usually sits in a circle, and the person leading signals a change of tune by lifting a bow or a flute; at the change everyone leaves a beat or two of space, then comes in together. Nobody counts in and nobody sets the tempo; the group finds the speed within a few beats, usually from the leader's first note, and the others follow. This works even in a session of strangers, because the repertoire and the rhythm types are a shared vocabulary.
同一個曲組裡，調性的安排也有講究。: Key is arranged with some care inside a set.
和台灣北管相比，差別在誰指揮與曲目的記法。北管由鼓手指揮，鼓點標記段落，嗩吶與鑼: Compared with Taiwan's beiguan, the difference is who directs and how the repertoire is remembered. Beiguan is directed by the drummer, the drum patterns mark the sections, and the suona and gongs are voiced for outdoors and for marching; a session has no conductor, tunes change when the leader lifts a bow or a flute, and the music is scaled to conversation in a room or a pub. Beiguan's repertoire is carried by oral transmission and manuscript books; a session's repertoire is remembered as tune sets and rhythm types.
和巴爾幹銅管相比，差別在節奏的組織：銅管以鼓切出七拍、九拍的不對稱分組，sess: Compared with Balkan brass, the difference is how rhythm is organised: brass bands use a drum to cut asymmetric groups of seven or nine beats, while a session sorts its repertoire by fixed rhythm types such as reel and jig, and the beat itself is not grouped by a drum.
和藍草樂隊相比，兩者都靠同一批曲目讓陌生人臨時合奏，差別在聲部的關係。藍草是分工: Compared with a bluegrass band: both rely on the same body of tunes to let strangers play together at short notice, and the difference is the relationship between the parts. Bluegrass divides the work — the mandolin chops, the double bass gives the root, only one instrument solos at a time; a session is unison playing, everyone blowing the same melody with differences only in ornament and breathing, and the bodhrán follows the phrases instead of locking the beat. A session's tune set is a string of tunes; a bluegrass number is a lead vocal trading with solos.
大部分時間所有人齊奏同一條旋律；吉他與手鼓提供和聲與拍點，但不是「伴奏組」。se: Most of the time everyone plays the same melody in unison; guitar and bodhrán give harmony and beat, but they are not an accompaniment section. The sound of a session is many copies of the same melody stacked together, not one melody with a layer behind it.
它不主導速度，也不從頭打到尾；好的手鼓手會跟著旋律的樂句走，在句尾加花、在長音上: It does not drive the tempo and it does not play from beginning to end; a good bodhrán player follows the phrases of the melody, adding ornament at the ends of phrases and leaving space under long notes. The tipper moves back and forth across the head, changing the point and the area of contact, so one drum can give both a high, dry tick and a low, full boom. Playing along with the melody like this is the opposite logic to a drum kit locking the beat.
小提琴、愛爾蘭長笛、錫口笛、手風琴: Fiddle, Irish flute, tin whistle, accordion
常見的做法是把同一調的幾首曲子串在一起，或讓前一首結束在關係調上、下一首從那裡接: A common approach is to string together several tunes in the same key, or to let one tune end in a related key and the next carry on from there. In the gap between tunes the players hear where the last harmony landed and decide which tune comes next; that decision is made on the spot, not written down beforehand. A set can therefore be adjusted to the players and the mood of the day, and the same batch of tunes can be put in different orders.
愛爾蘭 session 是一種表演，有固定的團員與節目單。: An Irish session is a performance, with fixed members and a programme.
愛爾蘭傳統樂隊有兩種形式。一種是 session：在酒館裡圍成一圈或一張桌子，每: The Irish traditional ensemble takes two forms. One is the session: a circle or a single table in a pub, everyone with their own instrument, no conductor, tunes strung together into sets. The other is the céilí band: a band made for dancing, with a fixed line-up and a fixed volume. Both draw on the same repertoire, but they solve different problems — the session solves how a group of strangers plays together, and the céilí band solves how the music gets over the sound of dancing feet.
愛爾蘭傳統樂隊（Irish Session and Céilí Band）— 在: Irish Session and Céilí Band — an Irish traditional ensemble that plays seated in a pub circle and links tunes into sets, together with the céilí band, which exists for dancing. Ensembles and instrumentation by Next Door Sound Weavers.

所有人齊奏同一條旋律，偶爾加裝飾與八度變化: Everyone plays the same melody in unison, with occasional ornament and octave shifts
找酒館現場的錄音，聽得到談話聲與杯子聲的那種；那是這個編制的自然環境。: Look for a live recording from a pub, the kind where you can hear talk and glasses; that is this line-up's natural habitat.
曲目類型包括 reel、jig、hornpipe、slip jig、polka: The tune types include reel, jig, hornpipe, slip jig, polka and slow air. A slow air is a free-rhythm lyrical melody, unsuited to unison playing; it is usually played by one person alone while the others listen quietly, and it is one of the few moments in a session when there is a soloist.
曲組（tune set）是 session 的形式單位。: The tune set is the session's unit of form.
歌與舞的分界也很清楚。reel 與 jig 是為跳舞而存在的，拍點必須穩；slo: The line between song and dance is clear too. Reels and jigs exist for dancing, so the beat has to be steady; a slow air exists for listening, with a free tempo and heavy ornament, usually played by one person alone. If someone starts a slow air in a session, the others stop and make room without any prior agreement.
注意手鼓的留白。它不從頭打到尾；聽它在哪裡停下來。: Listen for the bodhrán's silences. It does not play from beginning to end; hear where it stops.
節奏類型決定了身體感。reel 是四拍、流動的；jig 是六拍、分成兩組三拍；h: The rhythm type decides how the body feels. A reel has four flowing beats; a jig has six beats in two groups of three; a hornpipe has four beats with a swing from dotted notes; a slip jig has nine beats in three groups of three. The same melodic skeleton sounds completely different in each of these rhythm types, and session players switch between these bodily feelings within one evening.
聽曲組的接縫。兩首曲子之間通常有一兩拍的空白，然後整團一起進來；那個接縫是 se: Listen for the seams in a tune set. There is usually a beat or two of space between two tunes, then the whole group comes in together; that seam is where the session's sense of form lives.
聽齊奏的「不整齊」。每個人加的裝飾不同，不是完全一致；注意誰在句尾多了一個音。: Listen for the untidiness of the unison. Each player's ornament is different, not exactly matched; notice who adds an extra note at the end of a phrase.
調音與樂器選擇也跟著場合改變。: Tuning and the choice of instruments change with the occasion too.
